# ⚡ Android 16 GKI Kernel (`6.12.30`)

### 📲 Flashing Instructions
1. Download **`*-Bundle.zip`** for your root flavor and extract it.
2. Flash **`*-AnyKernel3.zip`** using **[Kernel Flasher](https://github.com/fatalcoder524/KernelFlasher/releases)** or Recovery. *(Vendor module bypass is built-in)*
3. Install the included **Root Manager APK** (`*.apk`).
4. Reboot your device.
5. *(Optional)* Flash **`Nethunter-Wireless-Modules.zip`** or **`NoMount-*.zip`** in your Root Manager.
